faqs.q: What is the Pinhole Surgical Technique?
faqs.a: The Pinhole Surgical Technique is a modern treatment for gum recession that Dr. Arellano offers here in San Francisco - a modern alternative approach to traditional gum grafting.
Yes - Invisalign clear aligners are part of our cosmetic dentistry services, along with teeth whitening, veneers, dental crowns, and bridges.

faqs.q: How long has Dr. Arellano been in practice?
faqs.a: Dr. Arellano has been serving general and cosmetic dentistry patients in San Francisco for more than 34 years.

faqs.q: Can you help with TMJ or jaw pain?
faqs.a: Yes - TMJ/TMD diagnosis and treatment is one of the practice's specialties. Call 415-752-8311 to schedule a consultation with Dr. Arellano.

faqs.a: Yes - Dr. Arellano is a snoring and sleep apnea specialist, and treatment for both is part of the practice.
